evals.prompt: Show a list of all products from the ProductEntity with their name and price. Add a delete button on each row that removes the product immediately when clicked.
evals.expected_output: A list rendering useEntityGetAll, deleting via useEntityDelete, rendering rows directly from data and relying on the SDK's optimistic removal — no manual list state, no refetch, no per-row spinners.
expectations: Uses useEntityGetAll(ProductEntity) to fetch data
Uses useEntityDelete for deletion
Renders rows directly from data — does not copy the list into useState or manually filter out deleted rows
Does not call refetch() manually after delete
Does not add per-row deleting spinners or loading state (the SDK removes the row optimistically)
Imports entity from @/product-types

evals.prompt: Build a form to create a new Task with a title and a status dropdown (todo, in-progress, done). On submit, save it to the TaskEntity and show a success toast. The form should reset after submission.
evals.expected_output: A form using useEntityCreate with correct data shape, a success toast (shadcn toast component on base apps; sonner on radix), and form reset after submission.
expectations: Uses useEntityCreate(TaskEntity)
Calls createFunction({ data: { ... } })
Shows a success toast — toast.add({ title, type: 'success' }) from @/components/ui/toast on base apps (toast.success() from sonner on radix)
Does not call refetch() after creation
Imports TaskEntity from @/product-types

evals.prompt: Build a user profile card that shows the current user's name, email, profile picture (with initials as fallback), and a logout button.
evals.expected_output: Uses useUser() for user data, AvatarImage with profileImageUrl, AvatarFallback with initials, logOut() from @blocksdiy/blocks-client-sdk/reactSdk.
expectations: Uses useUser() from reactSdk
Uses profileImageUrl for AvatarImage when available
Uses AvatarFallback with initials derived from firstName/lastName
Calls logOut() from @blocksdiy/blocks-client-sdk/reactSdk for the logout button
Does not try to edit user fields (UserEntity is immutable)

evals.prompt: Execute the GenerateReportAction with a date range input and show the streaming result as it comes in. Show a loading state while running and a clear button to reset.
evals.expected_output: Uses useExecuteAction with streamResult for real-time output, isLoading for state, and clear() to reset.
expectations: Uses useExecuteAction(GenerateReportAction)
Renders streamResult for real-time streaming output
Uses isLoading for loading state
Calls clear() to reset the result
Does not call the action inside onChange or other high-frequency handlers

evals.prompt: Add a file upload input that lets users upload an image. Show an upload progress bar while uploading and display the uploaded image preview when done.
evals.expected_output: Uses useFileUpload with uploadPercentage for progress and the returned URL for the preview image.
expectations: Uses useFileUpload() from reactSdk
Shows uploadPercentage for progress feedback
Stores and displays the returned URL string as an image src
Handles isLoading state to disable the input while uploading

evals.prompt: On the report detail page, add a 'Post to Slack' button that runs PostReportToSlackAction with the report id. Slack is an optional integration for this app, so many users won't have it connected.
evals.expected_output: The button is rendered only when useIntegrationStatus('slack').isConnected (or useIntegrationsStatus().isConnected('slack')) is true; the action runs through useExecuteAction; no connect-integration UI is built inside the app.
expectations: Imports useIntegrationStatus or useIntegrationsStatus from @blocksdiy/blocks-client-sdk/reactSdk
Hides or disables the Post to Slack button unless Slack is connected
Runs PostReportToSlackAction via useExecuteAction, imported from @/product-types
Does not rely only on catching the action's error to handle a missing Slack connection
Does not add a button or flow to connect Slack from inside the app
